_comment: Apple-hosted Background Assets packs (docs/NATIVE_PLAN.md §2). Built by pipeline/build_packs.py into data/packs/<id>.aar, uploaded LOCALLY by pipeline/upload_packs.sh (never from CI). Only OUR PMTiles go in packs (Apple-hosted = our hosting, docs/LICENSING.md) — never F2F chapters, Understorey Network photos or tree data sheets. Files keep their data/ names at the pack root: all packs share ONE namespace on the device, so a name must be unique across packs. The app mirrors this table by hand in ios/IzzyMap/Sources/Data/Packs.swift (Pack, Archive.pack). Asset-pack IDs can never be reused once archived in App Store Connect — don't rename casually. policy: essential = blocks first launch until downloaded (counts towards the App Store 'Up to' size); prefetch = starts with the install, may finish after launch; onDemand = only when the app asks (one tap).
